title: TownyElections
description: Let your townsfolk pick their leader! Run for office, win votes, and grab your new rank the moment the polls close.
body:
# TownyElections

Give your town a real election! Residents run for office, rally votes from their
fellow townsfolk, and the winner is crowned automatically the moment the polls
close. TownyElections adds a full, configurable democratic system on top of the
Towny plugin.

## What it does

Instead of the mayor's chair being handed out or claimed, let the people decide.
Candidates campaign with their own custom message, residents cast their votes,
and when the election ends the winner instantly receives the Towny town ranks
and/or mayorship you've configured. No manual rank assignment, no fuss.

## Features

- **Run for office** with `/election run`, and set a custom campaign message for
  voters to read.
- **Town voting** via `/election vote <candidate>`, with optional vote changing.
- **Full election lifecycle** handled for you: nomination, voting, an optional
  runoff round, then results.
- **Automatic winner rewards**: configurable Towny town ranks (plot management,
  councillor, etc.) and/or automatic mayorship.
- **Tie-breakers** you control: `RANDOM`, `EARLIEST`, `INCUMBENT`, `RUNOFF`, or
  `NONE`.
- **Auto-scheduling** to run recurring elections in every eligible town.
- **Secret or live ballots**, minimum/maximum candidates, custom durations, and
  more.
- **Renamable commands** so `/election` fits your server's style.
- **Custom win/loss commands** to run anything from console (LuckPerms grants,
  broadcasts, rewards, and so on).
- **PlaceholderAPI support** for election phase, time remaining, candidate count,
  vote count, and the last winner.
- **Persistent** across restarts, and **fully localised** with editable messages
  and hex colour support.

## Commands

| Command                        | Description                          |
|--------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| `/election run`                | Stand as a candidate.                |
| `/election withdraw`           | Withdraw from the race.              |
| `/election campaign <message>` | Set your campaign message.           |
| `/election vote <candidate>`   | Cast or change your vote.            |
| `/election status`             | View the current election.           |
| `/election candidates`         | List candidates and their pitches.   |
| `/election results`            | View the last election's results.    |
| `/election start [town]`       | (Admin) Start an election.           |
| `/election stop [town]`        | (Admin) End voting early and tally.  |
| `/election cancel [town]`      | (Admin) Cancel with no winner.       |
| `/election reload`             | (Admin) Reload the config.           |

## Requirements

- Paper **1.21.4+**
- Java **21+**
- **Towny** (required)
- **PlaceholderAPI** (optional)

## Getting started

1. Drop `TownyElections.jar` into your `plugins/` folder alongside Towny.
2. Start the server once to generate `config.yml` and `messages_en.yml`.
3. Tweak durations, ranks, and rewards to taste, then run `/election reload`.
4. Start an election with `/election start` and let the campaigning begin!
